description: This file implements RPC communication for Mattermost plugins, including client and server proxies, hook handling, error encoding, and plugin API methods, facilitating inter-process communication via RPC with streaming support.

classes.name: ErrorString
classes.description: A fallback error type for RPC transmission, preserving error message and code.

classes.name: hooksRPCClient
classes.description: Client-side proxy implementing hooks interface, forwarding calls via RPC.

classes.name: hooksRPCServer
classes.description: Server-side handler receiving RPC calls and delegating to plugin implementation.

classes.name: hooksPlugin
classes.description: Implements plugin.Plugin interface to connect plugin hooks and API over RPC.

classes.name: apiRPCClient
classes.description: Client-side proxy for API calls, forwarding via RPC.

classes.name: apiRPCServer
classes.description: Server-side handler for API calls, delegating to actual API implementation.

methods.name: encodableError
methods.description: Encodes errors for RPC transmission, wrapping non-registered errors into ErrorString.

methods.name: decodableError
methods.description: Decodes errors received via RPC into original error types.

methods.name: LoadPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Loads plugin configuration via RPC and unmarshals into provided destination.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles streaming of HTTP requests and responses over RPC.

methods.name: PluginHTTP
methods.description: Buffered version of HTTP plugin call over RPC.

methods.name: PluginHTTPStream
methods.description: Streaming version of PluginHTTP using MuxBroker for large payloads.

methods.name: FileWillBeUploaded
methods.description: Handles file upload streams via RPC, including replacement files.

methods.name: MessageWillBePosted
methods.description: RPC method invoked when a message is about to be posted, returning possibly modified post.

methods.name: MessageWillBeUpdated
methods.description: RPC method invoked when a message is about to be updated, returning possibly modified post.

methods.name: MessagesWillBeConsumed
methods.description: RPC method invoked when multiple messages are about to be consumed, returning modified posts.

methods.name: LogAuditRecWithLevel
methods.description: Logs audit records with specified level via RPC.

methods.name: InstallPlugin
methods.description: Uploads and installs a plugin via RPC.

methods.name: ServeMetrics
methods.description: Streams metrics data over RPC, including HTTP request/response handling.
